Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request & trust portal access — next steps

Hi Samira — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Scope: Cardinal Health Solutions is evaluating Redwood for clinical metadata enrichment; you flagged SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA coverage, and GDPR considerations as primary gating items.
- Deliverables we can provide this week: SOC 2 Type II summary (high level), a draft bridge letter, and an invite to our trust portal for evidence/evidence-exchange. See attachments.

Action items I proposed on the call (please confirm):
1) We’ll share the Type II summary + draft bridge letter (attachment).
2) We’ll provision portal access for your vendor-security team so you can pull artifacts and ask questions asynchronously.
3) If you need our completed vendor questionnaire (VSQ), Ben will drop our standard template and answer any clarifications.

If you can confirm the regulatory scope you need (HIPAA-only, HIPAA+GDPR, or additional provinces) that helps us prioritize which artifacts to surface first. Also sharing Michael Cho as alternate contact per the call.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_typeii_summary.pdf, redwood_bridge_letter_draft.pdf, vendor_qa_template.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll follow up once Marissa provisions the portal.

— Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0188

From: Samira Patel <s.patel@cardinalhealthsolutions.com>

Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2027 17:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request & trust portal access — next steps

Thanks Logan — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our security team: 

- We need confirmation that the SOC 2 Type II report covers the period covering Q2–Q3 2027 or an explanation of the latest reporting window. If the full Type II report isn’t available yet, a bridge letter + temporary attestation is fine short-term.
- Scope: HIPAA controls are required; GDPR applicability will depend on whether we process EU patient data in the pilot. Please mark HIPAA as primary.
- Please provide the VSQ (vendor security questionnaire) so our InfoSec team can triage. We’ll return it with any follow-ups.

Could you provision portal access for vendor-security@cardinalhealthsolutions.com and CC Michael so he has access? If you have a preferred SLA for artifact turnaround, let us know — we’d like to complete compliance review within two weeks of portal provisioning.

Best,
Samira Patel
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager — Cardinal Health Solutions
S.patel@cardinalhealthsolutions.com | +1 (617) 202-3344
